verdict.rationale: AvaTax is an API-first service: its REST v2 API and official SDKs in six languages let transactions be created and queried programmatically with no UI, so it can be driven headlessly from automation scripts. The evidence never documents a CLI, CI integration guides, or a dedicated sandbox environment for pipeline use; only the free trial is framed for testing. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI-specific tooling/docs, documented sandbox/test environment and credential handling for pipelines, independent corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
